title: PointlessCraft
description: PointlessCraft is a hilarious Minecraft mod that adds absurd and useless crafting recipes, turning everyday items into ridiculous new things. If you’re tired of practical gameplay and want to embrace chaos and nonsense, this mod is perfect for you!
body:
PointlessCraft
The ultimate Minecraft mod for crafting the utterly useless!

Are you tired of useful tools and sensible recipes?
Welcome to PointlessCraft — a mod that turns your Minecraft world upside down with absurd, pointless crafting recipes that make no sense at all!

-Craft diamonds out of dirt.

-Spawn villagers with bread.

-Turn diamonds into debug sticks.

And many more ridiculous recipes!

If you love chaos, nonsense, and a good laugh while playing Minecraft, PointlessCraft is the mod for you.
Why craft useful things when you can craft nonsense?

Highly recommended:
For the best experience, we strongly suggest installing Just Enough Items (JEI).
It helps you discover and browse all the ridiculous recipes PointlessCraft adds, so you never miss out on the fun!
